verdict.rationale: Phoenix's own docs say it is free to self-host with no feature limitations, keeps data in your infrastructure, and can be fully air-gapped. They document many deployment paths: CLI (`uvx arize-phoenix serve`), Docker/Compose, Kubernetes, Helm, CloudFormation, and one-click cloud templates, plus pinned Docker image versions for production. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Phoenix is free to self-host with no feature limitations. Your data stays entirely within your infrastructure—nothing is sent to Arize and can be fully air-gapped.
Terminal Run via CLI Docker Docker or Compose Kubernetes Deploy on K8s Helm Helm charts AWS CloudFormation
Pin to a specific version (e.g., `arizephoenix/phoenix:version-8.0.0`) for production deployments.
